title: Teradata Launches Integrated Enterprise Vector Store to Help Customers Be Ready to Implement Trusted Agentic AI
summary: Designed for cost-effective, sub-second response times at all data volumes, the new offering can solve multi-dimensional, complex problems by combining structured and unstructured data
body_markdown: Teradata empowers enterprises to turn intelligence into autonomous action, grounding AI agents in deep business context and trusted data. As AI agents multiply, Teradata is the context foundation, governance layer, and performance backbone that companies need now. The Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform puts AI into production across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Learn more at[Teradata.com](https://www.teradata.com/) .
